Kevin says happiness lives in the building, not the having.

Kevin Trudeau explains that we are happiest when we are creating, not when we are attaining. His example is a child at the beach who says "I want to build a sandcastle," never "I want to have one." Once it is built, the child wants to knock it down and build something else.

Kevin says the same goes for a garden, a business, a family or a relationship. The act of creating is where the joy is.

When did you last lose yourself in building something?

#ad #happiness #success #kevintrudeau

Kevin says one drive is stronger than the wish for pleasure.

Kevin Trudeau explains that most people think they are motivated by what will feel good. He says being motivated to avoid pain is more powerful. He quotes an NFL player who told him, "We love to win, but we hate losing more."

He adds Vince Lombardi's line: show me a good loser and I'll show you a loser. Kevin's point is that you can use the drive to avoid pain to get clear on what you really want.

What do you refuse to tolerate in your life anymore?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

A positive attitude can't do everything, but it does everything better.

Kevin Trudeau recalls a radio host asking if you can do anything with a positive attitude. His answer was no, but you can do everything better than with a negative one.

He then quotes his friend Zig Ziglar: it's your attitude, not your aptitude, that will determine your altitude in life. Kevin says it comes down to how you look at the situation.

How did you look at your last setback?
